name: verifier
title: Deterministic verifier
interface: CLI: node tools/verify.mjs [--dir <project>] [--json]. Loads contracts and submissions, validates schema and references, rejects cycles and self-imports, runs acceptance gates for submissions whose imports are all Done, derives statuses by fixpoint (cascade), enforces built-in laws, exits non-zero on structural errors or gate failures.
nl_description: The kernel analogue. Status is derived at read time, never stored; trust rests on this program plus the immutability check, not on any agent.
